vulnerability.name: USN-8168-2
vulnerability.description: USN-8168-1 fixed a vulnerability in Rust. This update provides the corresponding update to Ubuntu 14.04 LTS, Ubuntu 16.04 LTS, Ubuntu 18.04 LTS and Ubuntu 20.04 LTS.  Original advisory details:   It was discovered that tar-rs embedded in rustc incorrectly handled  symlinks when unpacking a tar archive. If a user or automated system were  tricked into processing a specially crafted tar archive, a remote attacker  could use this issue to modify permissions of arbitrary directories  outside the extraction root, and possibly escalate privileges.

statements.status_notes: rustc could be made to modify permissions on arbitrary directories.
